summary: Remote owner thread blocks on its request mailbox when idle (drain_with_wait, 500 ms) and polls every 10 ms only while a prompt, worker lane or steer is in flight.
commands_run: cargo test --locked --all-features --no-fail-fast --test remote_headless --test remote_headless_commands --test remote_worker_owner --test remote_worktree --test remote_worktree_runner --test remote_subtab --test remote_concurrency --test remote_parity --test remote_host_e2e --test remote_approval_wakeup
A/B: idle host serve/pair process, top csw over 10 s (/tmp probe)
notes: Deviation: the HeadlessHost prompt runner is not merged into the headless async host. Both already share ProjectOwnerPool and the runtime; the ~1200 LOC merge would only unify the concept. Idle shutdown is observed within 500 ms.
